olivia: quick brainstorm  tiny 'Code Sprint Snacks' launch: 3 bite-size tutorials, one micro-refapp, and a mentor-led drop-in session. need launch post, tutorial cadence, refapp repo, webinar funnel, and inbound routing.

tom: love the name. can reuse the tiny-refapp template, saves time.

mei: i'll draft the three tutorials (10-15m each) focused on prompts, batching, and quick deploy. will have drafts by Thu.

hal: i'll spin up the repo and add a `run-local.sh` + short README. MIT license. ETA Mon.

olivia: session format: 30m demo + 20m q&a. landing page gated, UTM params, HubSpot form. who owns emails?

mei: i'll own email drip: confirm, 24h reminder, follow-up with repo + replay.

tom: routing: tag leads `snacks_interest`; if they hit "talk to eng" or finish >50% labs, route to SE queue.

marketing-bot: task created /tasks/6021 assigned to @olivia @mei @hal, review due Wed 09:00 PT.

olivia: metrics to track: landing CTR, signups, attendance %, lab completions, repo stars, MQLs. add dashboards to Amplitude + HubSpot.

